details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:111-200 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Fingerprint file paths are used verbatim for open()/os.path.exists()/git lookups without repository-root containment checks.
  WHY: Reviewers agree absolute or ../ paths can escape the checkout and read or probe out-of-tree files, and the new out-of-tree regression expects rejection that is not implemented.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:541-558 | severity=medium | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Invalid must_contain regexes are counted in the denominator before compilation succeeds, so the satisfaction ratio includes patterns later skipped on re.error.
  WHY: Reviewers observed the 1/2 vs 1/1 mismatch and the compare-mode test expects invalid regexes to be excluded from the ratio.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:143-200 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Ref-mode git subprocesses have no timeout, so a hung git show/cat-file call can block the verifier indefinitely.
  WHY: The verifier runs inside the orchestrator poll cycle, so a stalled repo-plumbing command can stall the workflow with no internal escape.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:149-190 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Ref-mode git failures are mapped to content=None/exists=False instead of surfacing as plumbing errors.
  WHY: A typoed or invalid ref can look like an ordinary missing file, which can make must_not_exist checks pass silently and hide repository errors.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:652-703 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The CLI does not implement --baseline-fingerprints-state or --compare-against-baseline, so those invocations fall into the unknown-option exit-2 path.
  WHY: Every baseline-mode test and the orchestration harness call these flags and expect mode-specific behavior that the current parser never reaches.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:6228-6251 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The baseline-regression harness unconditionally imports and executes the new baseline suite even though the verifier lacks the required CLI support.
  WHY: Once those baseline tests hit exit 2 on the missing flags, the propagated assertion failure breaks the CI allowlisted test run.
- tests/test_verify_integration_fingerprints_baseline.py:68-448 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The baseline capture/compare suite assumes baseline-mode CLI support across 9 related tests, but the verifier rejects those flags as unknown.
  WHY: The capture, compare, fallback, malformed-baseline, mutual-exclusion, and ratio cases all invoke the unimplemented mode, so their rc/assertion expectations are unreachable today.
- tests/test_verify_integration_fingerprints_baseline.py:449-484 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The out-of-tree-path regression expects repository containment rejection that the verifier does not perform.
  WHY: Without a repo-root check, an absolute outside path is read/probed directly instead of failing with the expected error.
- docs/plans/sub-issue-test-runs-spike.md:4-268 | severity=medium | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The spike still points at docs/plans/integration-sync-resolver-self-heal-plan.md even though the closeout asks for that plan to be moved out of the active plans area.
  WHY: Reviewers agree the reference is stale/incomplete relative to the PR scope and the plan has not been archived in docs/completed/.
- docs/plans/sub-issue-test-runs-spike.md:88-111 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The spike’s schema/verification summary omits must_not_exist from the fingerprint contract.
  WHY: The actual verifier enforces path non-existence checks, so the document understates the gate’s coverage.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:119-179 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: Fingerprint file paths are used verbatim in open() and os.path.exists() with no repository-root containment check.
  WHY: An absolute path or ../ traversal path in the fingerprints JSON can read or probe files outside the checkout tree.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:652-703 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The verifier CLI does not implement --baseline-fingerprints-state or --compare-against-baseline.
  WHY: The parser only recognizes --list-violated-files and --ref, so any other leading --option reaches the unknown-option branch and returns exit code 2.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:541-555 | severity=medium | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: mc_total_expected is incremented before regex compilation, so invalid regexes still count in the denominator.
  WHY: With one valid regex and one invalid regex, the reported ratio becomes 1/2 instead of 1/1.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:6231-6247 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: This test unconditionally imports and executes every test_* function from tests/test_verify_integration_fingerprints_baseline.py with no guard for verifier compatibility.
  WHY: If any baseline test fails, the assertion propagates and fails this parent test.
- docs/plans/sub-issue-test-runs-spike.md:4-268 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The spike document references docs/plans/integration-sync-resolver-self-heal-plan.md at the active plans path, but the PR says the plan should be moved to docs/completed/.
  WHY: The closeout stated in the PR title/description is incomplete and the plan file still exists only at docs/plans/.
- docs/plans/sub-issue-test-runs-spike.md:90-111 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The spike describes the verification path as only checking must_contain and must_not_contain, and omits must_not_exist.
  WHY: The actual verifier enforces must_not_exist too, so the document understates the fingerprint gate's coverage.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:143-160 | severity=medium | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: The ref-mode git subprocess calls lack a timeout= parameter.
  WHY: A hung git process will block the verifier indefinitely and stall the orchestrator poll cycle.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:149-190 | severity=medium | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: Git failures in ref mode are silently mapped to file-absent behavior rather than surfaced as plumbing errors.
  WHY: A misspelled --ref value makes verification reports look like ordinary failures instead of a clear ref error.

=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:111-125 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: Fingerprint file paths are opened directly with open(path, "r", ...) without any repository-root containment check.
  WHY: Absolute paths or paths containing .. can escape the repository and read arbitrary files.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:176-193 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: Uses os.path.exists(path) directly without validating the path stays within repository boundaries.
  WHY: A fingerprint with an out-of-tree file path can be probed outside the checkout, violating the containment contract.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:655-703 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The verifier does not implement --baseline-fingerprints-state or --compare-against-baseline CLI flags.
  WHY: The parser only recognizes --list-violated-files and --ref flags, so other flags fall through to exit code 2.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:6231-6247 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: This test dynamically imports and executes the baseline test suite, which calls verifier flags that are not implemented.
  WHY: Running it triggers the unimplemented baseline suite and causes CI to fail.
- tests/test_verify_integration_fingerprints_baseline.py:68-448 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The baseline suite contains 9 related tests that all assume baseline-mode CLI support the verifier does not have.
  WHY: The capture, compare, fallback, malformed-baseline, mutual-exclusion, and ratio cases all hit exit code 2 instead of their expected behavior.
- tests/test_verify_integration_fingerprints_baseline.py:449-484 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The out-of-tree-path regression expects containment rejection, but the verifier has no path containment logic.
  WHY: An absolute or traversal path will be read directly instead of being rejected.
- docs/plans/sub-issue-test-runs-spike.md:6 | severity=medium | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The spike document references docs/plans/integration-sync-resolver-self-heal-plan.md, but the PR says the plan should be closed out and moved to docs/completed/.
  WHY: The reference is stale and the plan remains in docs/plans/ instead of being archived.

=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:123-195 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: Fingerprint file paths are used verbatim without repository-root containment checks in both working-tree and --ref modes.
  WHY: An absolute path or path with .. traversal in the fingerprints JSON can read or check file existence outside the repository checkout.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:684-700 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The verifier only recognizes --list-violated-files and --ref flags; baseline suite tests expect --baseline-fingerprints-state and --compare-against-baseline but the parser rejects them as unknown.
  WHY: CI will fail when the baseline suite runs against a verifier that does not implement those flags.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:551-558 | severity=medium | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: mc_total_expected is incremented before regex compilation, so invalid must_contain regexes count toward the denominator even after compile errors.
  WHY: The ratio output becomes 1/2 instead of 1/1 when one pattern fails to compile and one succeeds.
- tests/test_verify_integration_fingerprints_baseline.py:122-149 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The baseline-capture write-failure test expects a graceful failure when the output path is a directory, but the verifier does not implement baseline capture mode at all.
  WHY: The test cannot reach the write logic until the feature exists.
- tests/test_verify_integration_fingerprints_baseline.py:312-341 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: Compare-mode does not detect malformed baseline JSON and fall back to absolute verification as the test expects.
  WHY: When a baseline file is corrupted or unparseable, the verifier should warn and
